title: Canned job leaves out the fee that belongs to an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part with a part fee [Fee-1], set inactive in Setup. [Part-C] = one tracked part with a part fee [Fee-2], active.
  • Data: [Job-1] = a canned job holding [Part-A] with [Fee-1] and [Part-C] with [Fee-2].
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEE A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEE A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEE C), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-03), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-C] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-03); [Desc-C] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEE C).
  5. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEESRC Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEESRC-UNIT"); click Create.
  6. [WO-0] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  7. On [WO-0] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEESRC line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-0] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-0].
  8. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  9. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-C] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  10. On the [Part-A] row of [Line-0] open its ⋮ menu, click "Add Part Fee / Discount", pick Fee, Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL Disposal"), flat amount $5.00, save. [Fee-1] = that fee name.
  11. On the [Part-C] row open its ⋮ menu, click "Add Part Fee / Discount", pick Fee, Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL Shop"), flat amount $3.00, save. [Fee-2] = that fee name.
  12. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Save as canned line" and save it under the line's title. [Job-1] = that canned job name.
  13. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order", create the customer "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANFEE Customer" and unit "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANFEE-UNIT", click Create. [WO-1] = that work order number.
  14. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  15. Check the setup worked: Settings → Canned Lines → [Job-1] shows both parts with their fees. If the canned job did not keep the part fees, mark the case Blocked with 'canned job has no part fees'.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1].
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of [Job-1] in Title and pick the [Job-1] suggestion.
  4. Click "Save & Close".
  5. Read the warning at the bottom right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The new line holds [Part-C] with [Fee-2] ($3.00). Neither [Part-A] nor [Fee-1] ($5.00) is on it.
  • Step 5: One warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added: [Part-A]. The [Fee-1] fee for [Part-A] was not added." It stays until closed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-R10a, S9-R10, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas none (board 6.5 shows no fee). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists). Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §5 Modified endpoints.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R10a: “When a part left out carries a fee, the fee is left out too, and the same warning adds "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each one.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Canned job leaves out inactive parts): “"These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §5 Modified endpoints (apply canned line): “is the full S9-R10/R10a text ("These parts are inactive and were not added: A, B." + one "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." per fee)”
